# Vadaanya Janaa Society

> From Dreams to Degrees — bridging the gap between a government-school child's potential and a degree.

## About

Vadaanya Janaa Society is a registered non-profit organization (Reg. No. 1433/2010) established in November 2010 in Andhra Pradesh, India. The society is certified under 80G and 12A of the Indian Income Tax Act, making donations tax-deductible.

Founded by Ashok Padapati, the organization began when a group of friends committed to donating 0.5% of their monthly salaries to support underprivileged school children. Over 15 years, this initiative has grown into a statewide community non-profit serving 12 districts across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

## Mission

To improve the living standards of the destitute and needy through education — ensuring every child with a will to learn gets the chance to succeed, from Class 1 through post-graduation.

## Key Programs

- **Srinivasa Ramanujan Talent Test (Vadaanya Talent Test)**: A statewide scholarship examination for government school students (Classes 8–10), endorsed by the AP Education Ministry, conducted across 12 districts.
- **Scholarships & Financial Aid**: Direct financial support covering tuition, study materials, and living expenses from school through post-graduation.
- **Digital Empowerment & Infrastructure**: Provision of digital learning equipment and study tools for meritorious students pursuing higher education.
- **Mentorship & Career Guidance**: Weekend sessions with industry leaders, civil servants, and professionals.
- **Government Exam Preparation**: Free coaching, mock tests, and physical fitness training for Railway, Police, and Teaching competitive exams.
- **School Adoption**: Upgrading government schools with digital learning infrastructure and adaptive resources.

## Impact (Key Statistics)

- 15,000+ students evaluated through the Vadaanya Talent Test
- 400+ scholarships and stipends awarded
- 180+ digital learning tools & equipment provided to first-generation learners
- 15+ years of continuous operation (since 2010)
- Active across 12 districts in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana

## Founder

**Ashok Padapati** — Founder & President. B.Tech in Electrical & Electronics Engineering from SASTRA University (2006–2010). Quality Assurance professional at OpenText, Hyderabad. Born in Kothacheruvu village, Andhra Pradesh.

## Recognition & Awards

- Featured as a Change Leader on the Telugu talk show "Unstoppable"
- Conferred the "Yuva Bharat Gaurav" Award by Bharatiya Vikas Sangam
- Recognized at the CSR Summit for digital education initiatives
- Special invitee to the Andhra Pradesh Governor's Raj Bhavan "At Home" event
- Endorsed by the Andhra Pradesh Ministry of Education
